content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is an infrastructure solution that allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrency payments directly from customers. Unlike conventional payment platforms, these gateways eliminate the dependency on third-party services, giving creators full control over their sales. This is particularly important for those in regions with restrictive access to mainstream payment systems. By implementing a crypto gateway, creators can reduce transaction fees and improve their profit margins significantly, making it a vital tool for any digital entrepreneur.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment solution typically involves a combination of hosting services, backend logic, and payment processing. Platforms like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script can handle backend operations, while services like NOWPayments facilitate crypto transactions. This architecture allows for automated payment processing and product delivery. For example, when a customer makes a purchase, the payment is verified on-chain, and the product is delivered immediately. This seamless integration ensures a smooth purchasing experience without the overhead costs associated with traditional payment systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This solution is designed specifically for digital creators in underserved markets who are looking for efficient ways to sell products such as ebooks, courses, and templates. Creators in countries like Pakistan, Venezuela, and Zimbabwe often face barriers when using conventional payment platforms. By opting for a crypto payment gateway, they can bypass these barriers, retain more of their earnings, and build sustainable businesses. The focus is on empowerment and sovereignty, allowing creators to take full control of their digital commerce without being at the mercy of external financial systems.
Keep 99.5% of your earnings with low transaction fees.
The Components That Make It Work Together

To successfully implement a crypto payment gateway, several components must work in harmony. You need a hosting service, such as GitHub Pages for ease of access, a backend service like Supabase for order management, and NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Each component serves a specific purpose: hosting delivers your digital products, the backend manages transaction data, and the payment gateway facilitates secure and instant payments. Together, these elements create a robust infrastructure that supports seamless digital commerce.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling digital products via a crypto payment gateway, follow these steps: First, select a hosting provider like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up a backend using Google Apps Script or Supabase to manage your orders. Integrate NOWPayments for handling cryptocurrency transactions and ensure your digital products are ready for delivery. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that payments process smoothly and products are delivered automatically. By following these steps, you can establish a sovereign digital storefront quickly and efficiently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, you can use a crypto payment gateway that allows for direct cryptocurrency transactions. This approach not only bypasses traditional payment processors but also reduces fees, as platforms like NOWPayments only charge 0.5% compared to PayPal’s or Gumroad’s higher fees. This results in significant savings, allowing you to keep more of your earnings.
Automate delivery of digital products with seamless infrastructure.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For those interested in building a comprehensive digital commerce solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit priced at $197. This kit includes all necessary blueprints and templates to set up your sovereign stack, ensuring you can sell digital downloads effectively without relying on platforms like Gumroad or Payhip. You can explore this offering at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a crypto payment gateway?

A crypto payment gateway is a service that enables merchants to accept cryptocurrency payments directly. It offers a secure way to process transactions without relying on conventional payment processors, allowing creators to receive payments in various cryptocurrencies.
How do I implement a crypto payment solution?

To implement a crypto payment solution, choose a hosting platform, set up backend logic with services like Google Apps Script, and integrate a payment processor like NOWPayments. This setup automates transactions and ensures instant product delivery.
What are the benefits of using crypto payments?

Using crypto payments reduces transaction fees, increases transaction speed, and provides greater control over sales. It also allows creators to access a global market without the restrictions imposed by traditional payment systems.
Can I sell digital products without platform fees?

Yes, by utilizing a crypto payment gateway, you can significantly lower or eliminate platform fees associated with traditional payment processors. For example, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to higher fees from platforms like Gumroad.
What types of digital products can I sell?

You can sell various digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software. The flexibility of a crypto payment gateway allows you to cater to diverse audiences with these offerings.
Gain full control over your sales without third-party dependencies.
